left_to_supplement: Left to the supplement (coded, not analysed in the main text): bibliographic fields (identifiers, title, venue, year, first-author field, country, peer-review status); model details (exact version, access, tuning stage, parameter count, release and query dates, counts of models and families); paradigm details (name, source paper, item origin, item count, languages and modality at full text, contamination risk); human population and effect metric; the basis, authors' comparison, effect-size and agreement-value fields and headline of each effect row; coder notes; abstract-level number of models stated, human-comparison statement, codability and failed criterion; crossing details (sources crossed, decomposition types and sources, interaction pairs, evidence strings).
